blocks.en: Product Scenarios, Glossary and References

blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解預填充注射器（PFS）作為單一實體組合產品的 CGMP 合規策略 — Drug CGMP-based 或 Device QS-based 方法的選擇邏輯
blocks.en: Understand the CGMP compliance strategy for a prefilled syringe (PFS) as a single-entity combination product, and the logic for choosing between the Drug CGMP-based and Device QS-based approaches

blocks.zh: 掌握藥物塗層外科網片（Drug-coated mesh）的設計控制與採購控制要點
blocks.en: Grasp the key design control and purchasing control points for a drug-coated surgical mesh

blocks.zh: 分析藥物洗脫支架（DES）在 Device QS-based 方法下如何補充 8 項藥物 CGMP 規定
blocks.en: Analyze how a drug-eluting stent (DES) supplements the 8 drug CGMP requirements under the Device QS-based approach

blocks.zh: 熟悉組合產品核心詞彙：constituent part、PMOA、lead center、streamlined approach 等
blocks.en: Become familiar with core combination product terms: constituent part, PMOA, lead center, streamlined approach, etc.

blocks.zh: 建立無菌填充 CDMO 視角：PFS 業務的法規策略選擇與 CGMP 落地實踐
blocks.en: Build the perspective of a sterile fill-finish CDMO: regulatory strategy choices and practical CGMP implementation for PFS business

blocks.zh: Section V — 特定類型組合產品的 CGMP 要求
blocks.en: Section V: CGMP Requirements for Specific Types of Combination Products

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 三大情境案例地圖
blocks.en: Commentary: Map of the Three Scenarios

blocks.zh: 重要提示 — 不完全分析聲明
blocks.en: Important Note: Not a Complete Analysis

blocks.zh: FDA 明確指出：這些情境案例僅聚焦在 21 CFR 4.4(b) 列出的特定條款，不代表對該類產品所有 CGMP 問題的完整分析。
blocks.en: FDA states explicitly that these scenarios focus only on the specific provisions listed in 21 CFR 4.4(b) and do not represent a complete analysis of all CGMP issues for these types of products.

blocks.zh: 換言之：實際產品可能有額外的合規要求，廠商必須自行識別並聯繫 Lead Center 確認。
blocks.en: In other words: an actual product may carry additional compliance requirements, which the manufacturer must identify itself and confirm with the lead center.

blocks.zh: CDMO 策略視角
blocks.en: CDMO Strategic Perspective

blocks.zh: 對無菌填充 CDMO 而言，PFS 是最核心的業務場景。理解 Section A 的邏輯，就等於理解絕大多數無菌 CDMO 面對組合產品時的合規路徑選擇。
blocks.en: For a sterile fill-finish CDMO, PFS is the most central business scenario. Understanding the logic of Section A means understanding the compliance path that most sterile CDMOs face with combination products.

blocks.zh: 三個假設情境的核心邏輯
blocks.en: Core Logic of the Three Hypothetical Scenarios

blocks.zh: FDA 用三個案例，分別示範兩種 Streamlined Approach 的實際運作：
blocks.en: FDA uses three examples to show how the two streamlined approaches work in practice:

blocks.zh: Section V.A — 預填充注射器 (Prefilled Syringe)
blocks.en: Section V.A: Prefilled Syringe

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — PFS 情境背景
blocks.en: Commentary: PFS Scenario Background

blocks.zh: PFS 的法律定性
blocks.en: Legal Classification of a PFS

blocks.zh: 預填充注射器 = 單一實體組合產品（Single-entity combination product，21 CFR 3.2(e)(1)）
blocks.en: Prefilled syringe = single-entity combination product (21 CFR 3.2(e)(1))

blocks.zh: 藥物與注射器/針頭組件在物理上合為一體，不可分離 → 必須同時符合 Drug CGMP（21 CFR 210/211）和 Device QS（21 CFR Part 820）。
blocks.en: The drug and the syringe/needle components are physically integrated and cannot be separated, so the product must comply with both Drug CGMP (21 CFR 210/211) and Device QS (21 CFR Part 820).

blocks.zh: 比喻 — 廚房已裝修完成的餐廳
blocks.en: Analogy: A Restaurant with a Finished Kitchen

blocks.zh: 廠商 A（藥廠）等同於一間「已有廚房設備（藥物 CGMP 系統）的餐廳」，現在要新增一道「裝置菜單」（器械 QS 要求）。不需要整個廚房重建，只需在現有基礎上補充 6 項器械 QS 規定。
blocks.en: Firm A (the drug manufacturer) is like a restaurant that already has a kitchen (the drug CGMP system) and now wants to add a "device menu" (device QS requirements). The whole kitchen does not need to be rebuilt; it only needs 6 device QS provisions added on top of the existing foundation.

blocks.zh: 廠商 B（注射器組件供應商）= 食材供應商，已有設計控制資料可供廠商 A 槓桿使用。
blocks.en: Firm B (the syringe component supplier) is the ingredient supplier, whose existing design control data Firm A can leverage.

blocks.zh: Drug CGMP-based 方法 — 需補充的 6 項 Device QS 條款
blocks.en: Drug CGMP-based Approach: The 6 Device QS Provisions to Add

blocks.zh: 820.20 — Management Responsibility（管理責任）
blocks.en: 820.20: Management Responsibility

blocks.zh: 820.30 — Design Controls（設計控制）
blocks.en: 820.30: Design Controls

blocks.zh: 820.50 — Purchasing Controls（採購控制）
blocks.en: 820.50: Purchasing Controls

blocks.zh: 820.100 — CAPA（矯正與預防措施）
blocks.en: 820.100: CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action)

blocks.zh: 820.170 — Installation（安裝）— PFS 通常 N/A
blocks.en: 820.170: Installation (usually N/A for a PFS)

blocks.zh: 820.200 — Servicing（服務）— 單次使用 PFS 通常 N/A
blocks.en: 820.200: Servicing (usually N/A for a single-use PFS)

blocks.zh: CDMO 視角 — 為何藥廠偏好 Drug CGMP-based？
blocks.en: CDMO Perspective: Why Do Drug Manufacturers Prefer Drug CGMP-based?

blocks.zh: 無菌填充 CDMO 的核心能力是藥物製造（21 CFR 211）。補充 6 項 Device QS 條款遠比重建整套 Part 820 系統更可行。這也是行業主流選擇。
blocks.en: The core competence of a sterile fill-finish CDMO is drug manufacturing (21 CFR 211). Adding 6 Device QS provisions is far more feasible than rebuilding an entire Part 820 system. This is also the mainstream choice in the industry.

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 820.20 管理責任
blocks.en: Commentary: 820.20 Management Responsibility

blocks.zh: 820.20 vs 211 的管理責任條款差異
blocks.en: Differences Between the Management Responsibility Requirements of 820.20 and 211

blocks.zh: 21 CFR 211 已有管理責任相關要求（211.22 品質控制、211.25 人員資格、211.180 記錄要求），但 820.20 有更明確的器械專屬要求，包括：
blocks.en: 21 CFR 211 already contains management-responsibility-related requirements (211.22 quality control unit, 211.25 personnel qualifications, 211.180 record requirements), but 820.20 has more explicit device-specific requirements, including:

blocks.zh: 建立並維護書面品質政策（Quality Policy）
blocks.en: Establish and maintain a written Quality Policy

blocks.zh: 確保品質目標與整個組織溝通
blocks.en: Ensure quality objectives are communicated throughout the organization

blocks.zh: 指定管理代表（Management Representative）
blocks.en: Appoint a Management Representative

blocks.zh: 定期管理審查（Management Review）
blocks.en: Conduct periodic Management Review

blocks.zh: 實務重點
blocks.en: Practical Points

blocks.zh: 藥廠通常已有 QMS 文件，但 820.20 要求的「品質政策授權委派鏈」必須明確書面化 — 即誰負責將品質政策轉化為方法和程序，並在設施層級落實。
blocks.en: Drug manufacturers usually already have QMS documents, but the "chain of delegated authority for the quality policy" required by 820.20 must be clearly documented: that is, who is responsible for translating the quality policy into methods and procedures and implementing them at the facility level.

blocks.zh: 這在查廠時是常見查核點：FDA 查察官會追問「誰是 Management Representative？授權文件在哪？」
blocks.en: This is a common inspection focus: FDA investigators will ask, "Who is the Management Representative? Where is the document of authority?"

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 820.30 設計控制
blocks.en: Commentary: 820.30 Design Controls

blocks.zh: PFS 設計控制的核心邏輯
blocks.en: Core Logic of PFS Design Controls

blocks.zh: 對藥廠（Manufacturer A）而言，「設計」不是藥物配方（已核准），而是注射器如何與該藥物相容並安全遞送。
blocks.en: For the drug manufacturer (Manufacturer A), "design" is not the drug formulation (already approved) but how the syringe is compatible with the drug and delivers it safely.

blocks.zh: 藥物 = 設計輸入（Input）→ 注射器設計必須配合藥物特性
blocks.en: Drug = design input; the syringe design must fit the drug's characteristics

blocks.zh: 比喻 — 槓桿供應商設計資料
blocks.en: Analogy: Leveraging the Supplier's Design Data

blocks.zh: 廠商 B（注射器製造商）已有注射器的設計控制文件（DHF）。廠商 A 可以槓桿（leverage）這些資料，但需額外評估：
blocks.en: Firm B (the syringe manufacturer) already has design control documentation (DHF) for the syringe. Firm A can leverage these data, but must additionally evaluate:

blocks.zh: 加了該藥物後，有沒有新的設計問題？
blocks.en: Does adding this drug create any new design issues?

blocks.zh: 容器相容性（drug-syringe compatibility）
blocks.en: Container compatibility (drug-syringe compatibility)

blocks.zh: 滲出物/萃取物（leachables/extractables）
blocks.en: Leachables/extractables

blocks.zh: 若廠商 B 沒有設計控制資料，廠商 A 就必須自己做更廣泛的設計驗證（如注射力測試 glide force、柱塞力 plunger force）。
blocks.en: If Firm B has no design control data, Firm A must perform more extensive design verification itself (e.g., glide force and plunger force testing).

blocks.zh: 設計輸入輸出解讀 — 與無菌生產相關
blocks.en: Interpreting Design Inputs and Outputs: Relevance to Sterile Manufacturing

blocks.zh: 藥物黏度 → 針頭孔徑/注射力：高黏度蛋白質藥物需要大孔徑針頭或特殊針頭設計，這影響滅菌工藝選擇（針頭已附著或另外組裝）。
blocks.en: Drug viscosity and needle bore/injection force: High-viscosity protein drugs require a larger-bore needle or a special needle design, which affects the choice of sterilization process (needle pre-attached or assembled separately).

blocks.zh: 藥物/注射器接觸材質規格：矽化（siliconization）量、橡皮活塞材質、玻璃塗層 → 直接影響穩定性測試設計。
blocks.en: Specifications for drug/syringe contact materials: The amount of siliconization, the elastomer plunger material and the glass coating directly affect stability study design.

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 設計驗證、確認與風險分析
blocks.en: Commentary: Design Verification, Validation and Risk Analysis

blocks.zh: Verification vs Validation — 關鍵區別
blocks.en: Verification vs. Validation: The Key Difference

blocks.zh: Verification（驗證）：設計輸出是否滿足設計輸入的規格？→「Do we build the product right?」
blocks.en: Verification: Do the design outputs meet the design input specifications? "Did we build the product right?"

blocks.zh: Validation（確認）：產品是否滿足最終用戶的需求和預期用途？→「Do we build the right product?」
blocks.en: Validation: Does the product meet the needs of the end user and the intended use? "Did we build the right product?"

blocks.zh: 例：針頭孔徑規格測試 = Verification；臨床使用者能否正確自注射 = Validation（人因工程研究）
blocks.en: Example: needle bore specification testing = Verification; whether clinical users can self-inject correctly = Validation (human factors study)

blocks.zh: 無菌 PFS 必做的關鍵測試
blocks.en: Key Tests a Sterile PFS Must Have

blocks.zh: 滲出物/萃取物（L&E）：玻璃注射器的矽化油、橡皮活塞的添加劑可能滲入藥液 → 必須在穩定性條件下測試
blocks.en: Leachables/extractables (L&E): Silicone oil from the glass syringe and additives from the elastomer plunger may migrate into the drug solution, so testing under stability conditions is required

blocks.zh: 容器密封完整性（CCI）：針頭保護蓋、活塞密封 → 影響無菌保障
blocks.en: Container closure integrity (CCI): Needle shield and plunger seal affect sterility assurance

blocks.zh: 相容性研究：藥物不能改變注射器性能（如腐蝕玻璃）；注射器不能改變藥物特性（如蛋白質吸附）
blocks.en: Compatibility studies: The drug must not alter syringe performance (e.g., corroding the glass); the syringe must not alter drug properties (e.g., protein adsorption)

blocks.zh: 人因工程：患者自注射 → 用力、握持設計、針頭保護器操作
blocks.en: Human factors: Patient self-injection involves force required, grip design and needle guard operation

blocks.zh: 風險分析實務 — 無菌 PFS 高風險項目
blocks.en: Risk Analysis in Practice: High-Risk Items for a Sterile PFS

blocks.zh: 失去無菌性（Loss of Sterility）是最嚴重的風險，需要：
blocks.en: Loss of Sterility is the most severe risk and requires:

blocks.zh: 包裝完整性驗證（Package Integrity Validation）
blocks.en: Package Integrity Validation

blocks.zh: 容器密封完整性測試（CCI Test）— 21 CFR 211.165 要求
blocks.en: Container closure integrity (CCI) testing, as required by 21 CFR 211.165

blocks.zh: 運輸驗證（ISTA/ASTM 標準）
blocks.en: Transport validation (ISTA/ASTM standards)

blocks.zh: 注射器材料汙染藥物：購入控制 + 入廠檢驗（21 CFR 211.84）是雙重保障。
blocks.en: Contamination of the drug by syringe materials: Purchasing controls plus incoming inspection (21 CFR 211.84) provide double protection.

blocks.zh: CDMO 操作啟示 — DHF 建立策略
blocks.en: CDMO Operational Implications: DHF Establishment Strategy

blocks.zh: CDMO 作為接受委託廠商，需釐清「設計控制責任歸屬」：
blocks.en: As the contract manufacturer, the CDMO needs to clarify "who is responsible for design controls":

blocks.zh: 若客戶（品牌持有人）是 Owner → 設計控制由客戶主導
blocks.en: If the customer (the brand holder) is the Owner, design controls are led by the customer

blocks.zh: CDMO 負責製程驗證文件（可成為 DHF 的一部分）
blocks.en: The CDMO is responsible for process validation documents (which can become part of the DHF)

blocks.zh: 合約需明確規定設計資料的存取權限（for FDA inspection）
blocks.en: The contract must clearly specify access rights to design data (for FDA inspection)

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 設計變更與 DHF
blocks.en: Commentary: Design Changes and the DHF

blocks.zh: 設計變更的雙向影響
blocks.en: Two-Way Impact of Design Changes

blocks.zh: PFS 的設計變更需要同時考量兩個方向：
blocks.en: A design change to a PFS must be considered in two directions at once:

blocks.zh: 注射器材料變更 → 藥物：新材料是否與藥物相容？穩定性是否受影響？（觸發 21 CFR 211.137 和 211.167 穩定性要求）
blocks.en: Syringe material change → drug: Is the new material compatible with the drug? Is stability affected? (This triggers the stability requirements of 21 CFR 211.137 and 211.167.)

blocks.zh: 藥物配方變更 → 注射器：新配方是否影響注射器性能（如腐蝕性、黏度改變導致注射力不足）？
blocks.en: Drug formulation change → syringe: Does the new formulation affect syringe performance (e.g., corrosiveness, or a viscosity change leading to insufficient injection force)?

blocks.zh: 材料或配方變更時，FDA 允許廠商槓桿 211 穩定性數據來協助確定 820.30 驗證活動的範圍。
blocks.en: For material or formulation changes, FDA allows manufacturers to leverage 211 stability data to help determine the scope of 820.30 verification activities.

blocks.zh: DHF — 可以「指向」他處的設計文件
blocks.en: DHF: Design Documents Can Be "Pointed To" Elsewhere

blocks.zh: DHF 不需要把所有文件集中在一處，但必須能在查廠期間合理時間內取得。實務上：
blocks.en: The DHF does not need to hold all documents in one place, but they must be retrievable within a reasonable time during an inspection. In practice:

blocks.zh: 廠商 B 的注射器設計資料可存放在廠商 B，只要合約確保查廠時能調閱
blocks.en: Firm B's syringe design data can remain at Firm B, as long as the contract ensures they can be retrieved during an inspection

blocks.zh: 藥品開發報告（NDA/ANDA 資料）可以交叉引用為 DHF 輸入
blocks.en: Drug development reports (NDA/ANDA data) can be cross-referenced as DHF inputs

blocks.zh: 但「藥品研發本身」不受設計控制約束（因為是藥物開發，不是器械設計）
blocks.en: However, "drug development itself" is not subject to design controls (because it is drug development, not device design)

blocks.zh: CDMO 風險提示 — 供應商協議條款
blocks.en: CDMO Risk Alert: Supplier Agreement Terms

blocks.zh: CDMO 需在注射器組件供應商合約中明確規定：
blocks.en: The CDMO must specify the following in the contract with the syringe component supplier:

blocks.zh: 材料變更的事前通知義務（Change Notification）
blocks.en: Obligation to give prior notice of material changes (Change Notification)

blocks.zh: 設計文件的查廠調閱權
blocks.en: Right to retrieve design documents during an inspection

blocks.zh: 變更評估的協作流程
blocks.en: Collaborative process for change evaluation

blocks.zh: 缺乏這些條款，FDA 查廠時 DHF 不完整，將構成 483 觀察項。
blocks.en: Without these terms, the DHF will be incomplete during an FDA inspection, which would result in a Form 483 observation.

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 820.50 採購控制
blocks.en: Commentary: 820.50 Purchasing Controls

blocks.zh: PFS 採購控制的特殊性 — 雙重身份
blocks.en: The Special Nature of PFS Purchasing Controls: Dual Identity

blocks.zh: 注射器組件在 PFS 中扮演雙重角色：
blocks.en: The syringe components in a PFS play a dual role:

blocks.zh: 器械組成部分（Device constituent part）→ 820.50 採購控制
blocks.en: Device constituent part → 820.50 purchasing controls

blocks.zh: 藥物容器/密封（Container/closure for drug）→ 211.84 入廠檢驗
blocks.en: Container/closure for the drug → 211.84 incoming inspection

blocks.zh: 這意味著：注射器桶（barrel）、活塞（plunger）、針頭保護蓋必須同時滿足器械採購控制和藥物組件入廠檢驗要求。
blocks.en: This means that the syringe barrel, plunger and needle shield must satisfy both the device purchasing control requirements and the drug component incoming inspection requirements.

blocks.zh: Terminal Sterilization 外包的控制要求
blocks.en: Control Requirements for Outsourced Terminal Sterilization

blocks.zh: 若委外進行最終滅菌（如 EtO、伽瑪射線、電子束），該滅菌服務供應商也受 820.50 管控，需要：
blocks.en: If terminal sterilization is outsourced (e.g., EtO, gamma irradiation, e-beam), the sterilization service provider is also subject to 820.50 controls, which requires:

blocks.zh: 供應商評估與批准程序
blocks.en: Supplier evaluation and approval procedures

blocks.zh: 品質協議（Quality Agreement）
blocks.en: Quality Agreement

blocks.zh: 定期供應商稽核
blocks.en: Periodic supplier audits

blocks.zh: 滅菌批記錄的審查與核可
blocks.en: Review and approval of sterilization batch records

blocks.zh: 211.84 vs 820.50 — CDMO 入廠管控雙軌
blocks.en: 211.84 vs. 820.50: The CDMO's Dual-Track Incoming Controls

blocks.zh: PFS 的注射器組件兩者皆適用。
blocks.en: Both apply to the syringe components of a PFS.

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — CAPA 與 PFS 組合產品
blocks.en: Commentary: CAPA and PFS Combination Products

blocks.zh: CAPA 在組合產品的特殊要求
blocks.en: Special CAPA Requirements for Combination Products

blocks.zh: 820.100 CAPA 和 211 已有的變更管控（如 211.100 書面程序）邏輯相似，但 CAPA 的器械版本更強調：
blocks.en: 820.100 CAPA is similar in logic to the existing change controls in 211 (e.g., 211.100 written procedures), but the device version of CAPA places more emphasis on:

blocks.zh: 系統性問題根因分析（Root cause analysis）
blocks.en: Root cause analysis of systemic problems

blocks.zh: CAPA 有效性驗證（Effectiveness verification）
blocks.en: Verification of CAPA effectiveness

blocks.zh: 跨產品/跨系統的預防措施
blocks.en: Preventive actions across products and systems

blocks.zh: 案例 1 解析 — 填充量偏差
blocks.en: Case 1 Analysis: Fill Volume Deviation

blocks.zh: 根因：填充設備維護程序問題 → 非設備本身故障，而是維護 SOP 設計不足。
blocks.en: Root cause: A problem with the filling equipment maintenance procedure. It was not a failure of the equipment itself, but inadequate design of the maintenance SOP.

blocks.zh: CAPA 動作：更新維護 SOP + 驗證/確認設備改善後的填充準確性。
blocks.en: CAPA actions: Update the maintenance SOP, and verify/validate the filling accuracy after the equipment improvement.

blocks.zh: 這個案例強調：CAPA 不只是「修設備」，而是要追根到系統性原因並預防再發。
blocks.en: This case stresses that CAPA is not just "fixing the equipment"; it must trace back to the systemic cause and prevent recurrence.

blocks.zh: 案例 2 解析 — 無菌包裝破損
blocks.en: Case 2 Analysis: Sterile Package Breach

blocks.zh: 客訴觸發 CAPA → 調查發現是供應商（廠商 B）的未通知變更導致銳邊問題。
blocks.en: A complaint triggered a CAPA, and the investigation found that an unnotified change by the supplier (Firm B) caused a sharp-edge problem.

blocks.zh: CAPA 的多層動作：
blocks.en: Multi-level CAPA actions:

blocks.zh: 短期：與廠商 B 解決銳邊問題或更換供應商
blocks.en: Short term: Resolve the sharp-edge problem with Firm B, or replace the supplier

blocks.zh: 中期：強化入廠目視檢驗標準
blocks.en: Medium term: Strengthen the incoming visual inspection standard

blocks.zh: 長期：重新進行包裝設計驗證測試（設計控制的迴圈）
blocks.en: Long term: Repeat package design validation testing (the design control loop)

blocks.zh: 這展示了 CAPA → 採購控制 → 設計控制的跨系統連結。
blocks.en: This shows the cross-system link of CAPA → purchasing controls → design controls.

blocks.zh: 無菌包裝破損 — 監管重點
blocks.en: Sterile Package Breach: Regulatory Focus

blocks.zh: 無菌包裝完整性是無菌屏障系統（Sterile Barrier System）的關鍵。破損等同於潛在的無菌保障喪失（Breach of Sterility Assurance），可能觸發市場召回。預防的最佳手段是強健的 CAPA + 供應商變更管控。
blocks.en: Sterile package integrity is critical to the Sterile Barrier System. A breach equals a potential loss of sterility assurance (Breach of Sterility Assurance) and may trigger a market recall. The best prevention is a robust CAPA system plus supplier change control.
Commentary: 820.170 & 820.200 Not Applicable

blocks.zh: 為何 Installation 和 Servicing 不適用於 PFS？
blocks.en: Why Are Installation and Servicing Not Applicable to a PFS?

blocks.zh: 820.170 Installation（安裝）：適用於需要在使用現場安裝的設備類器械（如透析機、影像設備）。PFS 是一次性使用產品，由使用者直接取出注射，無需安裝程序。
blocks.en: 820.170 Installation: Applies to equipment-type devices that must be installed at the point of use (e.g., dialysis machines, imaging equipment). A PFS is a single-use product that the user takes out and injects directly, so no installation procedure is needed.

blocks.zh: 820.200 Servicing（服務/維修）：適用於需要售後維修保養的可重複使用器械。PFS 為單次使用（single-use）產品，使用後丟棄，無需維修服務。
blocks.en: 820.200 Servicing: Applies to reusable devices that require post-sale servicing and maintenance. A PFS is a single-use product that is discarded after use, so no servicing is needed.

blocks.zh: 這兩項在 Drug CGMP-based 方法中雖然必須「列示」，但廠商需在文件中說明不適用的理由（N/A with justification），不能留白。
blocks.en: Although these two provisions must be "listed" under the Drug CGMP-based approach, the manufacturer must document the reason they do not apply (N/A with justification) and may not leave them blank.

blocks.zh: 思考練習
blocks.en: Discussion Questions

blocks.zh: 如果 PFS 是搭配自動注射器（autoinjector）的組合，820.170 是否可能變得適用？請說明理由。
blocks.en: If the PFS is combined with an autoinjector, could 820.170 become applicable? Explain your reasoning.

blocks.zh: 廠商 A 的 Drug CGMP-based CGMP Operating System 需要哪 6 項 Device QS 條款？各條款的主要要求是什麼？
blocks.en: Which 6 Device QS provisions does Firm A's Drug CGMP-based CGMP Operating System need? What are the main requirements of each?

blocks.zh: 為什麼大多數藥廠/CDMO 選擇 Drug CGMP-based 而非 Device QS-based 方法？
blocks.en: Why do most drug manufacturers/CDMOs choose the Drug CGMP-based rather than the Device QS-based approach?

blocks.zh: Section V.B — 藥物塗層外科網片 (Drug-Coated Mesh)
blocks.en: Section V.B: Drug-Coated Surgical Mesh

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 藥物塗層網片情境
blocks.en: Commentary: Drug-Coated Mesh Scenario

blocks.zh: 情境 B 的法規結構
blocks.en: Regulatory Structure of Scenario B

blocks.zh: 廠商 A = 外科網片製造商（器械主導）→ 已有 Part 820 系統 → 選擇 Device QS-based Streamlined Approach
blocks.en: Firm A = surgical mesh manufacturer (device-led) → already has a Part 820 system → chooses the Device QS-based Streamlined Approach

blocks.zh: 廠商 B = 藥物供應商（提供塗布用藥物配方）
blocks.en: Firm B = drug supplier (supplies the drug formulation for coating)

blocks.zh: 情境 B 的重點不是「選哪種方法」，而是 Device QS-based 方法如何處理「藥物組成部分加入後」的設計控制與採購控制。
blocks.en: The point of Scenario B is not "which approach to choose" but how the Device QS-based approach handles design controls and purchasing controls once a drug constituent part is added.

blocks.zh: 比喻 — 廚師在現有菜單上加藥膳
blocks.en: Analogy: A Chef Adding a Medicinal Ingredient to an Existing Menu

blocks.zh: 廠商 A（器械廠）= 已有完整廚房設備的餐廳（Part 820 系統）。現在要在招牌菜（外科網片）上加上「藥用塗層」。整個廚房系統不用重建，但需要：
blocks.en: Firm A (the device manufacturer) = a restaurant with a complete kitchen (the Part 820 system). It now wants to add a "medicated coating" to its signature dish (the surgical mesh). The whole kitchen system does not need to be rebuilt, but it requires:

blocks.zh: 設計控制要加入「藥物劑量和藥效」的輸入要求
blocks.en: Design controls must add input requirements for "drug dose and efficacy"

blocks.zh: 採購控制要管控藥物供應商（廠商 B）
blocks.en: Purchasing controls must control the drug supplier (Firm B)

blocks.zh: Device QS-based 方法需補充的 8 項藥物 CGMP 條款
blocks.en: The 8 Drug CGMP Provisions to Add Under the Device QS-based Approach

blocks.zh: 在本情境中，廠商 A 採用 Device QS-based，需補充：
blocks.en: In this scenario, Firm A uses the Device QS-based approach and must add:

blocks.zh: 211.84 — 組件/容器/密封入廠測試
blocks.en: 211.84: Testing of components/containers/closures
211.103: Calculation of yield

blocks.zh: 211.132 — 防拆包裝（OTC 適用，本案 N/A）
blocks.en: 211.132: Tamper-evident packaging (applies to OTC; N/A in this case)
211.137: Expiration dating
211.165: Testing and release for distribution
211.166: Stability testing

blocks.zh: 211.167 — 特殊測試要求
blocks.en: 211.167: Special testing requirements
211.170: Reserve samples

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 藥物塗層網片的設計控制
blocks.en: Commentary: Design Controls for Drug-Coated Mesh

blocks.zh: Drug-device 複合設計的關鍵挑戰
blocks.en: Key Challenges of Drug-Device Combined Design

blocks.zh: 藥物洗脫速率（Elution Rate）是核心設計參數：
blocks.en: Drug elution rate is the core design parameter:

blocks.zh: 過快 → 藥物濃度超標、毒性風險
blocks.en: Too fast → drug concentration exceeds limits, toxicity risk

blocks.zh: 過慢 → 藥物濃度不足、無法治療感染
blocks.en: Too slow → drug concentration insufficient, infection cannot be treated

blocks.zh: 塗布均勻性（Coating uniformity）= 洗脫速率一致性的前提
blocks.en: Coating uniformity is the prerequisite for consistent elution rate

blocks.zh: 這個設計輸入/輸出的關係：藥效需求 → 塗布厚度和均勻度規格 → 生產製程參數。
blocks.en: The relationship between these design inputs and outputs: efficacy requirement → coating thickness and uniformity specifications → production process parameters.

blocks.zh: 設計審查人員的跨領域要求
blocks.en: Cross-Disciplinary Requirements for Design Reviewers

blocks.zh: FDA 明確要求：設計審查必須包含同時具備藥物和器械專業知識的人員（及獨立於審查階段之外的人員）。
blocks.en: FDA explicitly requires that design reviews include personnel with both drug and device expertise (as well as an individual who does not have direct responsibility for the design stage being reviewed).

blocks.zh: 這意味著器械廠商不能用純器械工程師團隊進行審查 — 必須引入藥物科學家或聘請顧問。對 CDMO 的啟示：跨功能設計審查委員會（Design Review Board）的組成必須包含臨床/藥理/藥物化學代表。
blocks.en: This means a device manufacturer cannot conduct the review with a team of device engineers only; it must bring in drug scientists or hire consultants. Implication for a CDMO: the cross-functional Design Review Board must include clinical, pharmacology and medicinal chemistry representatives.

blocks.zh: 穩定性研究的雙重考量
blocks.en: Dual Considerations in Stability Studies

blocks.zh: 外科網片的穩定性不只是「藥物效期」，還包括：
blocks.en: Stability for a surgical mesh is not just about "drug shelf life"; it also includes:

blocks.zh: 網片材料穩定性：藥物塗層是否改變網片的機械強度？
blocks.en: Mesh material stability: Does the drug coating change the mechanical strength of the mesh?

blocks.zh: 藥物穩定性：儲存條件下藥物含量是否維持？降解產物是否安全？
blocks.en: Drug stability: Is drug content maintained under storage conditions? Are the degradation products safe?

blocks.zh: 這是典型的「交互作用穩定性研究」— 不能只測藥物，也不能只測網片，要測組合後的整體。
blocks.en: This is a typical "interaction stability study": you cannot test only the drug or only the mesh; you must test the combined product as a whole.

blocks.zh: DHF 與上市申請資料的關係
blocks.en: Relationship Between the DHF and Marketing Application Data

blocks.zh: 藥物塗層網片的設計控制活動（驗證/確認資料）大多也需要提交給 FDA 進行上市前審查。廠商 A 可以：
blocks.en: Most of the design control activities (verification/validation data) for a drug-coated mesh also need to be submitted to FDA for premarket review. Firm A can:

blocks.zh: 將上市申請文件（premarket submission）以交叉引用方式納入 DHF
blocks.en: Incorporate the premarket submission documents into the DHF by cross-reference

blocks.zh: 利用藥物 B 的既有批准數據作為設計輸入的參考（槓桿既有藥物資料）
blocks.en: Use Firm B's existing approved data on the drug as a reference for design inputs (leveraging existing drug data)

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 採購控制 & 藥物供應商管理
blocks.en: Commentary: Purchasing Controls & Drug Supplier Management

blocks.zh: 器械廠管控藥物供應商的挑戰
blocks.en: Challenges for a Device Manufacturer Controlling a Drug Supplier

blocks.zh: 對器械廠（廠商 A）而言，管控藥物供應商（廠商 B）需要跨越傳統器械供應鏈管理的舒適區：
blocks.en: For a device manufacturer (Firm A), controlling the drug supplier (Firm B) means stepping outside the comfort zone of traditional device supply chain management:

blocks.zh: 需了解藥物規格（API purity、strength）和藥物製造的 CGMP 要求
blocks.en: Must understand drug specifications (API purity, strength) and the CGMP requirements for drug manufacturing

blocks.zh: 採購協議需包含藥物特有的變更通知觸發條件（配方、製程、設施）
blocks.en: Purchasing agreements must include drug-specific change notification triggers (formulation, process, facility)

blocks.zh: 211.84 入廠測試要求（包含身份確認、純度、效價）需建立在 Part 820 系統中
blocks.en: The 211.84 incoming testing requirements (including identity, purity and potency) must be built into the Part 820 system

blocks.zh: 變更通知義務 — 防止「隱形」組合產品問題
blocks.en: Change Notification Obligation: Preventing "Hidden" Combination Product Problems

blocks.zh: 藥物塗層網片的品質不只取決於自己的製程，也取決於廠商 B 的藥物品質。若廠商 B 未提前通知改變藥物濃度或製程，組合產品的洗脫速率可能悄悄改變，但廠商 A 毫不知情。
blocks.en: The quality of a drug-coated mesh depends not only on the manufacturer's own process but also on the drug quality from Firm B. If Firm B fails to give advance notice of a change in drug concentration or process, the elution rate of the combination product may shift silently without Firm A's knowledge.

blocks.zh: 這就是合約中「變更前通知義務（Prior Change Notification）」的重要性。
blocks.en: This is why the "Prior Change Notification obligation" in the contract is important.

blocks.zh: 廠商 A 採用 Device QS-based 方法，在不額外建立藥物 CGMP 系統的前提下，如何滿足 211.84 對藥物組件的入廠測試要求？
blocks.en: Firm A uses the Device QS-based approach. Without building a separate drug CGMP system, how can it meet the 211.84 incoming testing requirements for drug components?

blocks.zh: 如果廠商 B 是一家中型藥廠，廠商 A 如何在採購協議中確保有效的變更管控？列出 3 項合約必備條款。
blocks.en: If Firm B is a mid-sized pharmaceutical company, how can Firm A ensure effective change control in the purchasing agreement? List 3 essential contract clauses.

blocks.zh: Section V.C — 藥物洗脫支架 (Drug Eluting Stent, DES)
blocks.en: Section V.C: Drug-Eluting Stent (DES)

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — DES 情境結構
blocks.en: Commentary: DES Scenario Structure

blocks.zh: Device QS-based 方法 — 需補充的 8 項藥物 CGMP 條款
blocks.en: Device QS-based Approach: The 8 Drug CGMP Provisions to Add

blocks.zh: 211.84 — 組件/容器/密封入廠測試
blocks.en: 211.84: Testing of components/containers/closures

blocks.zh: 211.103 — 收率計算
blocks.en: 211.103: Calculation of yield

blocks.zh: 211.132 — 防拆包裝（本案 N/A — 非 OTC）
blocks.en: 211.132: Tamper-evident packaging (N/A in this case; not OTC)

blocks.zh: 211.137 — 有效期
blocks.en: 211.137: Expiration dating

blocks.zh: 211.165 — 放行測試
blocks.en: 211.165: Testing and release for distribution

blocks.zh: 211.166 — 穩定性測試
blocks.en: 211.166: Stability testing

blocks.zh: 211.167 — 特殊測試要求
blocks.en: 211.167: Special testing requirements

blocks.en: 211.170: Reserve samples

blocks.zh: CDMO 類比 — 器械 CDMO 承接 DES 的挑戰
blocks.en: CDMO Analogy: Challenges for a Device CDMO Taking On a DES

blocks.zh: 如果一家器械 CDMO 要承接 DES 代工，需要在既有 Part 820 系統基礎上建立 8 個藥物 CGMP 補充條款的執行系統 — 這是對器械廠合規體系的重大擴充，需要引進藥物 QA 人才。
blocks.en: If a device CDMO takes on contract manufacturing of a DES, it must, on top of its existing Part 820 system, build an implementation system for the 8 supplemental drug CGMP provisions. This is a major expansion of a device manufacturer's compliance system and requires bringing in drug QA talent.

blocks.zh: DES 的供應鏈複雜性
blocks.en: Supply Chain Complexity of a DES

blocks.zh: DES 是最複雜的組合產品之一，涉及 4 個主要參與者：
blocks.en: A DES is one of the most complex combination products, involving 4 main parties:

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 211.84 入廠測試 & 211.103 收率
blocks.en: Commentary: 211.84 Incoming Testing & 211.103 Yield

blocks.zh: 供應商 CoA 替代自行測試的條件
blocks.en: Conditions for Substituting a Supplier CoA for In-House Testing

blocks.zh: 不可替代的：身份確認測試（Identity test）— 每批必須自行執行，無例外。
blocks.en: Cannot be substituted: Identity testing must be performed in-house on every lot, without exception.

blocks.zh: 可替代的（滿足以下條件）：
blocks.en: Can be substituted (if the following conditions are met):

blocks.zh: 供應商在出貨前進行了符合性測試
blocks.en: The supplier performed conformance testing before shipment

blocks.zh: 廠商 A 已驗證供應商測試方法的可靠性
blocks.en: Firm A has validated the reliability of the supplier's test methods

blocks.zh: 定期再驗證供應商分析結果（at appropriate intervals）
blocks.en: The supplier's analytical results are periodically revalidated (at appropriate intervals)

blocks.zh: 211.103 收率計算 — DES 的獨特挑戰
blocks.en: 211.103 Yield Calculation: A Unique Challenge for a DES

blocks.zh: DES 的收率計算特別複雜，因為：
blocks.en: Yield calculation for a DES is particularly complex because:

blocks.zh: 藥物塗布工序：需要計算塗布前/後的藥物含量，確認收率
blocks.en: Drug coating step: Drug content must be calculated before and after coating to confirm yield

blocks.zh: 支架不良品淘汰：若支架本身有缺陷被剔除，附著的藥物也一併損失 → 這個藥物損耗必須計入收率，並調查支架不良率的根因
blocks.en: Rejection of defective stents: If a stent itself is defective and rejected, the drug attached to it is lost as well. This drug loss must be counted in the yield, and the root cause of the stent defect rate must be investigated

blocks.zh: 多工序收率：配方製備 → 塗布 → 固化 → 包裝，每個關鍵步驟都需要記錄
blocks.en: Multi-step yield: Formulation preparation → coating → curing → packaging; every critical step must be recorded

blocks.zh: 這個概念在純器械製造中沒有對應要求，是器械廠引入藥物 CGMP 後最陌生的項目之一。
blocks.en: This concept has no equivalent requirement in pure device manufacturing and is one of the most unfamiliar items for a device manufacturer adopting drug CGMP.

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — DES 藥物 CGMP 條款解析
blocks.en: Commentary: DES Drug CGMP Provisions

blocks.zh: 211.137 有效期 — DES 的多維度穩定性
blocks.en: 211.137 Expiration Dating: Multi-Dimensional Stability of a DES

blocks.zh: DES 的有效期設定需要考量所有影響有效期的因素，不只是藥物含量：
blocks.en: Setting the expiration date for a DES must consider all factors that affect shelf life, not just drug content:

blocks.zh: 藥物含量衰減（Drug assay over time）
blocks.en: Drug assay over time

blocks.zh: 藥物洗脫速率的穩定性（Release rate stability）
blocks.en: Release rate stability

blocks.zh: 聚合物完整性（Polymer integrity）
blocks.en: Polymer integrity

blocks.zh: 支架塗層的附著力（Coating adhesion）
blocks.en: Coating adhesion on the stent

blocks.zh: 初級包裝的密封完整性（Package seal integrity）
blocks.en: Package seal integrity of the primary packaging

blocks.zh: 若不同尺寸 DES 具有相似設計，FDA 允許槓桿既有穩定性數據，前提是有充分科學依據且已獲 FDA 審查。
blocks.en: If different DES sizes share a similar design, FDA allows leveraging existing stability data, provided there is sound scientific justification and the data have been reviewed by FDA.

blocks.zh: 211.165 DES 放行測試清單解析
blocks.en: 211.165: DES Release Testing List

blocks.zh: 藥物洗脫速率（Drug Release Rate）是最關鍵的 DES 專屬測試：
blocks.en: Drug release rate is the most critical DES-specific test:

blocks.zh: 即釋型（Immediate release）vs 緩釋型（Extended release）— 設計不同，測試方法不同
blocks.en: Immediate release vs. extended release: different designs call for different test methods

blocks.zh: 體外溶出測試（In vitro dissolution）作為批放行代理指標
blocks.en: In vitro dissolution as a surrogate for batch release

blocks.zh: 聚合物殘留單體、催化劑測試 — 確保聚合物加工殘留物不超標
blocks.en: Testing for polymer residual monomers and catalysts, to ensure polymer processing residues do not exceed limits

blocks.zh: 211.167 特殊測試 — 無菌 + 控制釋放雙重要求
blocks.en: 211.167 Special Testing: Dual Requirements for Sterility and Controlled Release

blocks.zh: 211.167(a) — 無菌/非致熱原：每批 DES 必須進行無菌試驗和內毒素/致熱原測試（或同等無菌保障程序）。
blocks.en: 211.167(a): Sterile/pyrogen-free: Every DES lot must undergo sterility testing and endotoxin/pyrogen testing (or an equivalent sterility assurance procedure).

blocks.zh: 211.167(c) — 控制釋放劑型：藥物洗脫支架屬於控制釋放劑型（controlled-release），必須進行額外的溶出/釋放速率測試，確認藥物按預期速率釋放。
blocks.en: 211.167(c): Controlled-release dosage forms: A drug-eluting stent is a controlled-release dosage form, so additional dissolution/release rate testing is required to confirm the drug is released at the intended rate.

blocks.zh: DES 合規思考練習
blocks.en: DES Compliance Discussion Questions

blocks.zh: 廠商 A（器械廠）採用 Device QS-based 方法，需補充 8 項藥物 CGMP 條款。如果廠商 A 的 QA 人員完全沒有藥物 CGMP 背景，請列出最需要立即培訓的 3 個優先領域。
blocks.en: Firm A (a device manufacturer) uses the Device QS-based approach and must add 8 drug CGMP provisions. If Firm A's QA staff have no drug CGMP background, list the 3 priority areas that most need immediate training.

blocks.zh: DES 的穩定性測試計畫應涵蓋哪些測試項目？與一般固體口服製劑的穩定性計畫有何差異？
blocks.en: What test items should a DES stability testing plan cover? How does it differ from the stability plan for a typical solid oral dosage form?

blocks.zh: 廠商 A 可以委託第三方機構保存保留樣品。需要在哪個合規框架下進行管控？
blocks.en: Firm A may contract a third party to store reserve samples. Under which compliance framework must this be controlled?

blocks.zh: 211.170 保留樣品 — 雙層保留義務
blocks.en: 211.170 Reserve Samples: Dual Retention Obligation

blocks.zh: DES 的保留樣品義務分兩個層次：
blocks.en: The reserve sample obligation for a DES has two layers:

blocks.zh: 委外保留樣品的第三方儲存設施也受 820.50 管控，需要品質協議。
blocks.en: A third-party storage facility holding reserve samples under contract is also subject to 820.50 controls and requires a quality agreement.

blocks.zh: Section VI — 聯繫 FDA
blocks.en: Section VI: Contacting FDA

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 聯繫 FDA 的策略
blocks.en: Commentary: Strategy for Contacting FDA

blocks.zh: Lead Center vs OCP — 先找誰？
blocks.en: Lead Center vs. OCP: Whom to Contact First?

blocks.zh: FDA 建議先聯繫 Lead Center（主要審查中心）：
blocks.en: FDA recommends contacting the Lead Center (the primary reviewing center) first:

blocks.zh: CDER：藥物主導（PMOA 是藥物）的組合產品 → 如 PFS、DES
blocks.en: CDER: Combination products led by drugs (PMOA is the drug), e.g., PFS, DES

blocks.zh: CDRH：器械主導的組合產品 → 如外科網片、骨科植入物
blocks.en: CDRH: Combination products led by devices, e.g., surgical mesh, orthopedic implants

blocks.zh: CBER：生物製品主導的組合產品 → 如細胞治療裝置
blocks.en: CBER: Combination products led by biological products, e.g., cell therapy devices

blocks.zh: OCP（Office of Combination Products）= 處理跨中心爭議和 PMOA 認定（RFD — Request for Designation）的辦公室。
blocks.en: OCP (Office of Combination Products) = the office that handles disputes across centers and PMOA determinations (RFD: Request for Designation).

blocks.zh: 比喻 — 組合產品的「管轄法院」
blocks.en: Analogy: The "Jurisdictional Court" for Combination Products

blocks.zh: Lead Center 就像管轄法院：一般問題找管轄法院（Lead Center）即可。若對管轄權有疑問（PMOA 不確定），就找「最高法院」（OCP）進行裁定（RFD）。
blocks.en: The Lead Center is like the court with jurisdiction: for general questions, go to that court (the Lead Center). If there is doubt about jurisdiction (PMOA unclear), go to the "supreme court" (OCP) for a ruling (RFD).

blocks.zh: CDMO 在早期開發階段應主動送 RFD 確認 Lead Center，以避免後期合規方向走錯。
blocks.en: A CDMO should proactively submit an RFD in early development to confirm the Lead Center, to avoid heading in the wrong compliance direction later.

blocks.zh: 申請會議的途徑
blocks.en: Routes for Requesting a Meeting

blocks.zh: 廠商可依 Lead Center 的現行程序申請諮詢會議：
blocks.en: A manufacturer may request a consultation meeting under the Lead Center's current procedures:

blocks.zh: CBER/CDER：Type A/B/C 會議（Formal Meeting Request）
blocks.en: CBER/CDER: Type A/B/C meetings (Formal Meeting Request)

blocks.zh: CDRH：Pre-Submission（Q-Sub）程序
blocks.en: CDRH: Pre-Submission (Q-Sub) program

blocks.zh: OCP：直接寫信或電話說明問題
blocks.en: OCP: Write or call directly to describe the question

blocks.zh: Section VII — 詞彙表 (Glossary)
blocks.en: Section VII: Glossary

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 核心詞彙學習重點
blocks.en: Commentary: Key Learning Points on Core Terms

blocks.zh: 三種組合產品的分類記憶法
blocks.en: A Memory Aid for the Three Types of Combination Products

blocks.zh: 依包裝/結合方式分類：
blocks.en: Classified by packaging/combination method:

blocks.zh: Single-entity（單一實體）：已物理/化學結合 → 1個NDC/PMA/510(k)
blocks.en: Single-entity: Physically/chemically combined → 1 NDC/PMA/510(k)

blocks.zh: Co-packaged（共同包裝）：各自獨立但裝在同一盒 → 各自有獨立的上市批准
blocks.en: Co-packaged: Independent products in the same box → each has its own separate marketing approval

blocks.zh: Cross-labeled（交叉標示）：分開包裝分開賣，但標示規定必須搭配 → 各自有批准但標示連結
blocks.en: Cross-labeled: Packaged and sold separately, but labeling requires use together → each has its own approval but the labeling is linked

blocks.zh: 三種類型的 CGMP 要求邏輯相同，但 cross-labeled 情況下，各家廠商只對自己負責製造的 constituent part 負 CGMP 責任。
blocks.en: The CGMP requirement logic is the same for all three types, but for cross-labeled products, each manufacturer is responsible for CGMP only for the constituent part it manufactures.

blocks.zh: Owner — 委外不免責
blocks.en: Owner: Outsourcing Does Not Remove Responsibility

blocks.zh: Owner（上市授權持有人）對整個組合產品的 CGMP 合規負最終責任，即使委外製造（如委託 CDMO 填充）。
blocks.en: The Owner (marketing authorization holder) bears ultimate responsibility for CGMP compliance of the entire combination product, even when manufacturing is outsourced (e.g., to a CDMO for filling).

blocks.zh: 這意味著：CDMO 的合規狀況直接影響品牌持有人的法規責任。品牌持有人必須透過品質協議（Quality Agreement）和供應商稽核確保 CDMO 符合要求。
blocks.en: This means the CDMO's compliance status directly affects the brand holder's regulatory responsibility. The brand holder must ensure the CDMO meets requirements through a Quality Agreement and supplier audits.

blocks.zh: 詞彙應用練習
blocks.en: Glossary Application Exercises

blocks.zh: 一家無菌 CDMO 受委託充填生物製劑至預填充注射器，並交由品牌持有人銷售。試問：誰是 Owner？CDMO 的 CGMP 責任範圍為何？
blocks.en: A sterile CDMO is contracted to fill a biologic into prefilled syringes, which are then sold by the brand holder. Who is the Owner? What is the scope of the CDMO's CGMP responsibility?

blocks.zh: 一家廠商將抗菌藥物塗覆在導尿管上，分開包裝銷售，標示說明需配合使用。這是哪種類型的組合產品？應由哪個 FDA 中心主導審查（PMOA 提示：藥物治療感染）？
blocks.en: A manufacturer coats an antimicrobial drug onto a urinary catheter and sells it in separate packaging, with labeling stating that it must be used together. Which type of combination product is this? Which FDA center should lead the review (PMOA hint: the drug treats infection)?

blocks.zh: 用自己的話解釋「Streamlined Approach」對一家剛獲得 PFS 產品委託的藥廠意味著什麼。
blocks.en: In your own words, explain what the "Streamlined Approach" means for a drug manufacturer that has just been contracted to make a PFS product.

blocks.zh: 兩種 Streamlined Approach 比較
blocks.en: Comparison of the Two Streamlined Approaches

blocks.zh: 選擇依據：現有 CGMP 系統的主體是什麼。不要把補充條款少誤認為「更容易」— 兩套各有其深度要求。
blocks.en: Basis for choosing: what the core of the existing CGMP system is. Do not mistake fewer supplemental provisions for "easier"; each approach has its own depth of requirements.

blocks.zh: Section VIII — 參考資料 (References)
blocks.en: Section VIII: References

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 參考資料使用指引
blocks.en: Commentary: Guide to Using the References

blocks.zh: 對無菌 CDMO 最重要的參考文件
blocks.en: The Most Important Reference Documents for a Sterile CDMO

blocks.zh: 依重要性排序：
blocks.en: In order of importance:

blocks.zh: [3] 玻璃注射器技術指引（Glass Syringes ISO 11040-4）— PFS 填充必讀，涵蓋玻璃規格、矽化、相容性測試標準
blocks.en: [3] Glass syringe technical guidance (Glass Syringes, ISO 11040-4): Essential reading for PFS filling; covers glass specifications, siliconization and compatibility testing standards

blocks.zh: [23] 無菌藥品製造指引（FDA Aseptic Processing 2004）— 無菌填充的核心 GMP 要求
blocks.en: [23] Sterile drug products guidance (FDA Aseptic Processing, 2004): The core GMP requirements for aseptic filling

blocks.zh: [9] 容器密封系統指引（Container Closure Systems）— 注射器作為藥物容器的相容性、CCI 要求
blocks.en: [9] Container closure systems guidance (Container Closure Systems): Compatibility and CCI requirements for a syringe as a drug container

blocks.zh: [10] 合約製造安排/品質協議（Quality Agreements）— CDMO 合約必備
blocks.en: [10] Contract manufacturing arrangements/quality agreements (Quality Agreements): Essential for CDMO contracts

blocks.zh: [1] 人因工程指引（Human Factors）— 自注射產品的 PFS 設計驗證
blocks.en: [1] Human factors guidance (Human Factors): PFS design validation for self-injection products

blocks.zh: [30] 注射器/自動注射器技術考量（Pen/Jet Injectors）— 自動注射器組合產品設計要求
blocks.en: [30] Technical considerations for syringes/autoinjectors (Pen/Jet Injectors): Design requirements for autoinjector combination products

blocks.zh: ICH Q 系列的穩定性群組
blocks.en: The ICH Q Series Stability Group

blocks.zh: 參考文件 14-18 是 ICH Q1 系列穩定性測試規範的完整清單：
blocks.en: Reference documents 14-18 are the complete list of the ICH Q1 series stability testing standards:

blocks.zh: Q1A(R2)：新藥物穩定性基本要求（長期/加速/壓力條件）
blocks.en: Q1A(R2): Basic stability requirements for new drug substances (long-term/accelerated/stress conditions)

blocks.zh: Q1B：光穩定性測試
blocks.en: Q1B: Photostability testing

blocks.zh: Q1C：新劑型的穩定性測試
blocks.en: Q1C: Stability testing for new dosage forms

blocks.zh: Q1D：Bracketing/Matrixing 設計（減少穩定性樣品數）
blocks.en: Q1D: Bracketing/Matrixing designs (reducing the number of stability samples)

blocks.zh: Q1E：穩定性資料評估和有效期外推
blocks.en: Q1E: Evaluation of stability data and extrapolation of shelf life

blocks.zh: DES 和藥物塗層網片的穩定性計畫應引用這些指引建立測試矩陣。
blocks.en: Stability plans for DES and drug-coated mesh should cite these guidances when building the test matrix.

blocks.zh: [27] DES 草案指引 — 仍為草案
blocks.en: [27] DES Draft Guidance: Still a Draft

blocks.zh: 「Coronary Drug-Eluting Stents – Nonclinical and Clinical Studies」（2008 年草案）截至本指引發布時（2017 年）仍為草案（Draft），最終版尚未發布。廠商應查詢最新狀態。
blocks.en: "Coronary Drug-Eluting Stents – Nonclinical and Clinical Studies" (2008 draft) was still a Draft when this guidance was issued (2017), and the final version had not been published. Manufacturers should check its current status.

blocks.en: Recommended CDMO Compliance Document Library

blocks.en: API management: [19]

blocks.zh: Section V–VIII 學習總結
blocks.en: Summary of Sections V–VIII

blocks.zh: PFS (Section V.A) — Drug CGMP-based 方法核心要點
blocks.en: PFS (Section V.A): Key Points of the Drug CGMP-based Approach

blocks.zh: PFS 是 Single-entity combination product — 必須同時符合 Drug CGMP + Device QS
blocks.en: A PFS is a single-entity combination product and must comply with both Drug CGMP and Device QS
Drug manufacturer/CDMO chooses Drug CGMP-based → adds 6 Device QS provisions: 820.20, 820.30, 820.50, 820.100, 820.170 (N/A), 820.200 (N/A)

blocks.zh: 注射器組件 = 器械組成部分 + 藥物容器/密封 → 820.50 + 211.84 雙重要求
blocks.en: Syringe components = device constituent part + drug container/closure → dual requirements of 820.50 + 211.84

blocks.zh: 設計控制重點：L&E、CCI、藥物-注射器相容性、人因工程
blocks.en: Design control focus: L&E, CCI, drug-syringe compatibility, human factors

blocks.zh: 820.170 和 820.200 對單次使用 PFS 不適用，但需書面說明理由
blocks.en: 820.170 and 820.200 do not apply to a single-use PFS, but the reason must be documented

blocks.zh: 藥物塗層網片 (Section V.B) — Device QS-based 方法
blocks.en: Drug-Coated Mesh (Section V.B): Device QS-based Approach

blocks.zh: 器械廠以 Part 820 為主體，補充 8 項 Drug CGMP 條款
blocks.en: The device manufacturer uses Part 820 as its core and adds 8 Drug CGMP provisions

blocks.zh: 設計控制必須引入藥物科學專業（跨領域設計審查）
blocks.en: Design controls must bring in drug science expertise (cross-disciplinary design review)

blocks.zh: 藥物洗脫速率、塗布均勻性是核心設計輸出規格
blocks.en: Drug elution rate and coating uniformity are the core design output specifications

blocks.zh: 採購控制需管控藥物供應商，包含變更前通知義務
blocks.en: Purchasing controls must control the drug supplier, including the prior change notification obligation

blocks.zh: DES (Section V.C) — Device QS-based + 8 項 Drug CGMP
blocks.en: DES (Section V.C): Device QS-based + 8 Drug CGMP Provisions

blocks.zh: 最複雜的組合產品 — 4 家供應商、多工序製程
blocks.en: The most complex combination product: 4 suppliers, multi-step process

blocks.zh: 211.84：API + 聚合物 + 初級包裝分別測試；身份確認不可用 CoA 替代
blocks.en: 211.84: API, polymer and primary packaging are each tested; identity testing cannot be replaced by a CoA

blocks.zh: 211.103 收率：支架不良品淘汰的藥物損耗也要計入收率
blocks.en: 211.103 yield: drug loss from rejected defective stents must also be counted in the yield

blocks.zh: 211.165 放行測試必含藥物洗脫速率測試
blocks.en: 211.165 release testing must include drug elution rate testing

blocks.zh: 211.170 保留樣品：原料藥（最後一批 DES 有效期後 1 年）+ 成品（有效期後 1 年）
blocks.en: 211.170 reserve samples: drug substance (1 year after expiration of the last DES lot) + finished product (1 year after expiration)

blocks.zh: CDMO 實戰決策框架
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Decision Framework

blocks.zh: 無菌填充 CDMO — PFS 合規策略選擇
blocks.en: Sterile Fill-Finish CDMO: PFS Compliance Strategy Choice

blocks.zh: 結論：選擇 Drug CGMP-based Streamlined Approach。
blocks.en: Conclusion: Choose the Drug CGMP-based Streamlined Approach.

blocks.zh: 理由：
blocks.en: Reasons:

blocks.zh: CDMO 核心能力在藥物製造（21 CFR 211），現有系統是 Drug CGMP
blocks.en: The CDMO's core competence is drug manufacturing (21 CFR 211), and its existing system is Drug CGMP

blocks.zh: 補充 6 項 Device QS 條款（主要是 820.20/820.30/820.50/820.100）遠比重建整套 Part 820 系統更務實
blocks.en: Adding 6 Device QS provisions (mainly 820.20/820.30/820.50/820.100) is far more practical than rebuilding an entire Part 820 system

blocks.zh: 820.170 和 820.200 對 PFS 不適用，實際補充工作量更少
blocks.en: 820.170 and 820.200 do not apply to a PFS, so the actual supplemental workload is smaller

blocks.zh: 大多數客戶（品牌持有人）的 CMC 體系也是 Drug CGMP 主導
blocks.en: Most customers (brand holders) also have a CMC system led by Drug CGMP

blocks.zh: CDMO 承接 PFS 業務的合規清單
blocks.en: CDMO Compliance Checklist for Taking On PFS Business

blocks.zh: 820.20：確認品質政策、管理代表指定、管理審查程序
blocks.en: 820.20: Confirm quality policy, management representative appointment and management review procedures

blocks.zh: 820.30：建立 PFS 的 DHF，包含設計輸入/輸出、V&V 計畫、風險分析
blocks.en: 820.30: Establish the DHF for the PFS, including design inputs/outputs, V&V plan and risk analysis

blocks.zh: 820.50：注射器組件供應商評估 + 採購協議（變更通知條款）
blocks.en: 820.50: Syringe component supplier evaluation + purchasing agreement (change notification clause)

blocks.zh: 211.84：注射器組件的入廠測試程序（身份、純度、外觀）
blocks.en: 211.84: Incoming testing procedures for syringe components (identity, purity, appearance)

blocks.zh: 820.100：CAPA 程序涵蓋組合產品特有場景
blocks.en: 820.100: CAPA procedure covering scenarios specific to combination products

blocks.zh: 820.170/820.200：書面確認不適用，並說明理由
blocks.en: 820.170/820.200: Document that they do not apply, with justification

blocks.zh: 品質協議：與客戶（品牌持有人 / Owner）明確劃分設計控制責任
blocks.en: Quality agreement: Clearly divide design control responsibility with the customer (brand holder / Owner)

blocks.zh: 最終總結 — 兩種方法的選擇邏輯
blocks.en: Final Summary: The Logic for Choosing Between the Two Approaches

blocks.zh: 選擇的關鍵不是「哪個更容易」，而是「現有系統是哪個？」
blocks.en: The key to the choice is not "which is easier" but "which system do you already have?"
